d: The political battle for Punjab ahead of the 2027 Assembly Elections has taken a major turn as the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) have announced their alliance. Union Home Minister Amit Shah declared the alliance, saying that the NDA is now complete in the true sense. SAD president Sukhbir Singh Badal also expressed confidence in forming a double-engine government in Punjab.
